$comment: Copy to .claude/settings.json in the consuming project and COMMIT it, so the
whole team gets the same guardrails.
This is the ENFORCED half of core/guardrails.md. Prose in a standards file is
advisory - the model can misread it, or an instruction elsewhere can outweigh
it. These rules are applied by the harness before a tool runs, so they hold
regardless of what the model concluded.
deny = blocked outright. ask = prompts for approval every time.
Verify the matcher syntax against your Claude Code version with /permissions
before relying on it - schema details do change between releases.
1. prose in core/  - the model should follow it
2. permissions     - the harness asks or refuses before a tool runs
3. hooks           - the harness runs code on tool events
Hooks are the only layer that can act. Copy templates/hooks/ to .claude/hooks/
alongside this file, or the hook commands below will silently no-op.
